designationHistory.indexText: Cape Romain 1800s Lighthouses Established in 1932 as a migratory bird refuge, the refuge's original objectives were to conserve in public ownership habitat for waterfowl, shorebirds and seabirds, and resident species.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
